title: Calculus of Interfaces — @shuding
note: A React dashboard compiled into a real math function: exact card velocity on prop changes, gradient search for layout goals, proof a layout never breaks, all visual breakpoints, smoothest path between layouts. Her steal: project-grid filter/resize transitions where cards glide to new rows and lift slightly mid-flight instead of teleporting, built with Motion layout. Demo: http://calculus-of-interfaces.vercel.app
